name: Needle
description: Fast automatic projectile. Each level adds 35% base damage.

name: Pulse
description: Automatic close-range burst; cover blocks enemy damage. +35% damage per level.

name: Satellite
description: Orbiting construct deals contact damage. +35% damage per level.

name: Grenade
description: Automatically lobbed explosive: real soil excavation and visible-area damage. +35% damage per level.

name: Piercing
description: Needle penetrates one additional enemy per level; cover still stops it.

name: Echo
description: Every fifth primary activation repeats at 30/45/60% damage. Secondary hits do not repeat.

name: Rupture
description: Primary kills explode for 5 damage per level in a 1.8-unit visible radius. No recursive procs.

name: Chain
description: Primary hits jump to a nearby visible enemy for 3 damage per level. No recursive procs.

name: Inertia
description: Stand for 0.75 world seconds to charge +40% damage per level on the next moving attack. One charge.

name: Momentum
description: After 2 moving world seconds gain +15% attack speed per level; fades over 1 world second.

name: Lens
description: +15% additive range, -5 maximum HP per copy.

name: Capacitor
description: +25% additive damage, -10% additive attack speed per copy.

name: Light Frame
description: +12% additive move speed, -1 armor per copy.

name: Armor Plate
description: +2 armor, -5% additive move speed per copy.

name: Magnet
description: +0.7 pickup radius per copy.

name: Core
description: +15 maximum HP per copy. Does not heal.

name: Stabilizer
description: +15% additive attack speed per copy.

name: Shard
description: +8 percentage points critical chance per copy; capped at 75%.

name: Amplifier
description: +0.3 critical multiplier per copy.

name: Ring
description: +15% additive effect radius per copy.

name: Regenerator
description: Regenerate 0.3 HP per world second per copy.

name: Coupon
description: Rerolls cost 2 less per copy; minimum price 1.
